name: interfaces
description: Completion, hover, snippets, diagnostics and quick fixes for the LO-TEK design system: the <lt-*> elements, the lt- classes and their variants.

lotek.languages.description: The languages, as VS Code language ids, in which the extension checks the markup and completes classes and values. The snippets do not follow it: they apply in the languages of this default list. Completion of the <lt-*> elements from VS Code's own HTML service applies only to html.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outfile dist/extension.js --target node --format cjs --external vscode && bun build src/server.ts --outfile dist/server.js --target node --format cjs && rm -f dist/lotek-core.wasm dist/snippets.json && cp ../interfaces/core/lotek.wasm dist/ && mkdir -p dist/manifest && cp ../interfaces/manifest/manifest.json dist/manifest/ && cp ../interfaces/html-data.json dist/ && bun scripts/build-snippets.ts
scripts.check: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out lotek.vsix
